seeds.name: Convert a large generated release-notes document to HTML
seeds.stdin:
## Release notes

This release addresses **performance** issues in the `parser` module and adds
*several* new capabilities for downstream consumers. See the [changelog](https://example.com/changelog)
for the full history.

- Improved throughput for large batches
- Reduced allocations in the tokenizer
- Fixed a rare panic when `input` was empty

| Metric | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Latency (ms) | 120 | 95 |
| Throughput (req/s) | 800 | 1050 |
| Memory (MB) | 64 | 51 |

> Note: this benchmark was run on a reference machine; your results may vary.

```go
func Process(item Item) (Result, error) {
	if item.ID == 0 {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("item: missing id")
	}
	return Result{ID: item.ID, Score: item.Score * 2}, nil
}
```

1. Review the release notes above
2. Update your configuration file
3. Run the migration script
4. Verify the health check endpoint
seeds.description: Default HTML conversion of a repeated release-notes block (heading, bold/italic, link, list, table, blockquote, fenced code, ordered list) piped on stdin; the header is written once and the block 4,000 times.
